J1 (controller), J2 (platform engineer), J4 (methods reviewer): the release is built from source with git, Node 20, npm install and a build (README.md:313, :331-339), with no installer or package, so installing it is an IT ticket; there is no signed release or tag (README.md:313), no public CI running the test suites and bench check (README.md:355), no SBOM and no written period for which issued verdicts will replay, so nothing anchors the tree's reproducibility claims outside the authors' control
